headline:

الخميس بتوقيت الإمارات
label: فعالية
note: Blizzard official post (news.blizzard.com article 24315820, 29 Oct) launch times table: WoW: Forever live 4 Nov 23:00 UTC (3:00 pm PST, 11:00 pm UK, 12:00 am CET 5 Nov, 10:00 am ANZ). Gulf times derived: UTC+4 = 03:00 Thu 5 Nov UAE, UTC+3 = 02:00 KSA. IGN 2 Nov carried the time guide (new angle: launch hours away, first Gulf-time statement). More than 1,000 new quests across levels 1 to 60 from the same Blizzard post. Footage: official Launch Dungeons Overview trailer (IGN copy of Blizzard video, 1080p, 4.4 Mbps), gameplay only; the Warpath AMV trailer was letterboxed 2.39:1 at 1.7 Mbps so not used.
